name: GST Registration
meta_title: GST Registration Online | Get GSTIN in 3 to 7 Days
meta_description: Apply for GST registration online with CA support. Correct HSN codes, quick GSTIN and full guidance on returns. Upload documents online or WhatsApp them to us.
excerpt: Get your GSTIN quickly with error free filing, correct HSN codes and expert guidance on what happens after registration.
intro: GST registration is the first tax step for most Indian businesses. It gives you a GSTIN, lets you collect tax lawfully, claim input tax credit and sell on e-commerce platforms.

Eaccountingcart files your GST application with the correct business category, HSN codes and place of business details, the three areas where most self filed applications get stuck. Share your documents on this page or over WhatsApp and our CA team handles the rest, including replies to any query from the officer.
what: GST registration is mandatory once your turnover crosses forty lakh rupees for goods or twenty lakh rupees for services (lower limits apply in special category states). It is compulsory regardless of turnover for e-commerce sellers, businesses making inter state taxable supplies and those liable under reverse charge. Registration is granted as a 15 digit GSTIN linked to your PAN.
who: Businesses crossing the turnover threshold for goods or services
Sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and other e-commerce platforms
Service providers billing clients in other states
Exporters and importers of goods or services
Voluntary applicants who want input tax credit and B2B credibility
benefits: Legal Authority to Collect GST
Charge and collect GST on invoices lawfully and pass on credit to business customers.
Input Tax Credit
Claim credit of GST paid on purchases and expenses, which directly reduces your tax cost.
E-commerce Access
A GSTIN is compulsory for selling on major online marketplaces.
Interstate Sales Without Limits
Supply goods and services across India without state wise restrictions.
Stronger Business Profile
Corporate buyers and government departments prefer GST registered vendors.
documents: PAN card of the business or proprietor
Aadhaar card of the proprietor, partners or directors
Photograph of the applicant
Business address proof: electricity bill or property tax receipt
Rent agreement and NOC if premises are rented
Bank account proof: cancelled cheque or bank statement
Certificate of incorporation and board resolution for companies
Digital signature for companies and LLPs
process: Consultation
We confirm whether registration is mandatory or beneficial for you and pick the right scheme, regular or composition.
Document Collection
Upload documents through this page or WhatsApp them to our team.
Application Filing
We file Form GST REG-01 with correct HSN or SAC codes and business details, and complete Aadhaar authentication.
Query Handling
If the officer raises a clarification, we draft and file the reply within the deadline.
GSTIN Delivery
You receive your GSTIN and certificate, along with a simple guide on invoicing and return due dates.
validity: Lifetime for regular taxpayers, subject to return filing
fees_note: No government fee for GST registration
why_us: Wrong HSN codes and vague business descriptions cause rejections and future notices. Our CA team files it right the first time and stays available for your returns and notices afterwards.
faqs: Is GST registration free?
Yes, the government charges no fee. You only pay professional fees for expert preparation, filing and query handling, which prevents costly errors later.
Should I choose the composition scheme?

Composition suits small businesses with turnover up to one and a half crore rupees that sell locally to consumers. It means lower tax and simpler returns but no input credit and no interstate sales. We evaluate your numbers before choosing.
Can I register voluntarily below the threshold?
Yes. Voluntary registration helps if your buyers want GST invoices or you pay significant GST on purchases. Remember that once registered, returns must be filed even for zero sales.
What happens after I get my GSTIN?
You must issue GST compliant invoices and file returns every month or quarter. We provide a return filing plan so you never miss a due date or lose input credit.

intro: Every GST registered business must file returns even in months with no sales. Late or incorrect filing brings late fees, interest, blocked input credit and eventually suspension of your GSTIN.

Eaccountingcart takes over your entire GST return cycle. Send your sales and purchase data monthly through email or WhatsApp, and we reconcile, prepare and file everything on time, with a confirmation to you after each filing.
what: Regular taxpayers file GSTR-1 for outward supplies and GSTR-3B for tax payment, monthly or quarterly under the QRMP scheme. Input tax credit must be matched with GSTR-2B, the auto drafted statement of credits, before claiming. Composition taxpayers file quarterly CMP-08 and annual GSTR-4 instead.
who: Every business with an active GSTIN, including those with nil turnover
Businesses losing input credit due to poor purchase reconciliation
Sellers on e-commerce platforms with TCS credits to claim
Businesses that have received late fee or mismatch notices

Maximum Input Credit

Error Free Data

Notice Prevention
Consistent, matched filings sharply reduce the chance of departmental scrutiny.
Time Back for Business
You send data once a month; we handle the entire portal work.

Purchase invoices or purchase register
Credit and debit notes issued or received
E-commerce sales reports if you sell online

faqs: Do I need to file returns if I had no sales?
Yes. Nil returns are mandatory for every active GSTIN. Missing them accumulates late fees daily and can lead to suspension of your registration.
What is GSTR-2B and why does it matter?
GSTR-2B is the monthly statement of input credit based on what your suppliers filed. You can generally claim credit only if the invoice appears there, so reconciliation before filing is essential.
What is the QRMP scheme?
Businesses with turnover up to five crore rupees can file returns quarterly while paying tax monthly. It reduces filing work; we advise whether it suits your cash flow.
Can you fix my pending or defective past returns?
Yes. We regularise pending returns, compute late fees and interest correctly and restore your compliance rating before taking over routine filing.

name: GST Annual Return Filing
meta_title: GST Annual Return Filing | GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C Online
meta_description: File GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C accurately with CA led reconciliation of books and returns. Avoid mismatch notices. Share your data online or on WhatsApp.
excerpt: CA led preparation of GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C with full books versus returns reconciliation before filing.
intro: The GST annual return is where the whole year's filings meet your books of accounts. Differences between the two are the single biggest source of GST notices, so this return deserves professional care, not a last minute copy paste.
Eaccountingcart reconciles your books, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2B line by line, resolves the differences and files GSTR-9 and, where applicable, the GSTR-9C reconciliation statement.
what: GSTR-9 is the annual return mandatory for taxpayers with turnover above two crore rupees, consolidating all supplies, credits and taxes for the financial year. GSTR-9C is a reconciliation statement between the annual return and audited financials, required above five crore rupees of turnover. The usual due date is 31 December following the financial year.
who: Businesses with annual turnover above two crore rupees (GSTR-9)
Businesses above five crore rupees turnover (GSTR-9 plus GSTR-9C)
Taxpayers with differences between books and monthly returns
Businesses that claimed or reversed large input credits during the year
benefits: Notice Protection
Reconciled annual returns close the year cleanly and reduce scrutiny risk.
Recovery of Missed Credit
Annual review often surfaces eligible credit missed during monthly filings.
Correct Disclosure of Adjustments
Amendments, credit notes and RCM entries are reported in the right tables.
Audit Ready Records
The reconciliation working papers become your defence file if a query ever comes.
Expert Sign Off
GSTR-9C certification and review by professionals who do this at scale.
documents: Audited financial statements for the year
All GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filings of the year
GSTR-2B statements and input credit registers
Sales and purchase registers from your accounting software
Details of RCM payments, credit notes and amendments
GST portal login credentials
process: Data Compilation
We pull your full year returns from the portal and collect books data from you.
Reconciliation
Turnover, tax and input credit are reconciled between books, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2B.
Difference Resolution
Every gap is explained, adjusted or documented with reasons before filing.
Draft Review

Filing
Returns are filed before the due date and the acknowledgment is shared with working papers.
timeline: 7 to 15 working days depending on data quality
validity: Annual filing, typically due 31 December after the financial year
fees_note: Late filing attracts late fees of up to 0.50 percent of turnover
why_us: Annual returns filed without reconciliation simply postpone problems to the notice stage. We resolve differences now, when they are cheap to fix, and document every position.
faqs: Is GSTR-9 mandatory for my business?
GSTR-9 is mandatory if aggregate turnover exceeded two crore rupees in the financial year. Below that it is optional, though filing can still be useful to lock the year's positions.
What is the difference between GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C?

GSTR-9 is the annual return of transactions. GSTR-9C is a reconciliation between that return and your audited accounts, required above five crore rupees of turnover and certified after professional review.
Can errors from monthly returns be fixed in GSTR-9?
GSTR-9 discloses corrections but does not allow fresh credit claims beyond the cut off. That is why we review your data before deadlines, so fixable issues are corrected in monthly returns first.
What happens if I skip the annual return?
Late fees accrue daily and the department can issue notices and block future compliance. Persistent default invites assessment based on available data, which is usually unfavourable.

name: GST LUT Filing
meta_title: GST LUT Filing Online | Export Without Paying IGST
meta_description: File your Letter of Undertaking (LUT) online and export goods or services without paying IGST. Same week filing by CA experts. Documents on WhatsApp.
excerpt: File your annual Letter of Undertaking and export goods or services without blocking cash in IGST.
intro: Exporters can ship goods and services without paying IGST by filing a Letter of Undertaking (LUT). Without a valid LUT you must pay tax first and claim a refund later, which locks up working capital for months.
Eaccountingcart files your LUT on the GST portal, usually within a day of receiving documents, and tracks the annual renewal so your zero rated exports never get interrupted.
what: The LUT is filed in Form GST RFD-11 and is a commitment to complete exports within prescribed timelines and follow GST rules. It covers exports of goods, export of services and supplies to SEZ units without payment of IGST. The LUT is valid for one financial year and must be filed fresh each year.
who: Exporters of goods shipping outside India
IT, consulting and other service exporters billing foreign clients
Suppliers to SEZ units and SEZ developers
Freelancers with foreign clients whose receipts qualify as export of services
benefits: No Cash Blocked in IGST
Export without paying tax upfront instead of waiting months for refunds.
Simple Annual Filing
One filing covers all your exports for the entire financial year.
SEZ Supplies Covered
Supplies to SEZ units also go tax free under the same LUT.
Better Pricing Power
Freed up working capital lets you quote more competitively.
Clean Compliance Trail
A valid LUT keeps your export invoices and returns consistent.
documents: GST portal login credentials
PAN of the business
Details of two witnesses with ID proof
Authorised signatory details
Previous LUT copy if renewing
IEC certificate (for goods exporters)
process: Eligibility Check
We confirm your exports qualify for LUT and that no disqualification applies.
Document Collection
Basic KYC and witness details are collected on WhatsApp.
Online Filing
Form RFD-11 is prepared and filed on the GST portal with digital verification.
Acknowledgment
You receive the LUT acknowledgment to quote on export invoices.
Renewal Tracking
We remind and refile your LUT before the new financial year starts.
validity: One financial year; renewal required every year
fees_note: No government fee for LUT filing
why_us: Exporters lose refunds and get demand notices simply because a renewal date slipped. We maintain a renewal calendar for every client so April never catches you without a valid LUT.
faqs: What happens if I export without a valid LUT?
You must pay IGST on the export and claim a refund later, or risk a demand with interest if you shipped tax free without cover. Filing the LUT first is always cheaper.
Do service exporters and freelancers need an LUT?
Yes, if you invoice foreign clients without charging IGST, a valid LUT is the legal basis for it. This applies to IT companies, consultants and freelancers alike.
When should the LUT be renewed?
Before the start of each financial year, ideally in March. The LUT is valid only for the year in which it is filed.
Can anyone file an LUT?
Any registered exporter can, except those prosecuted for tax evasion above two and a half crore rupees. Such persons must furnish a bond with bank guarantee instead.

name: GST Cancellation and Surrender
meta_title: GST Cancellation Online | Surrender Your GSTIN Properly
meta_description: Close your GST registration the right way: final return, stock reversal and clean exit without future notices. CA managed process. Documents on WhatsApp.
excerpt: Surrender your GSTIN cleanly with the final return and credit reversals done right, so old registrations never haunt you.
intro: Closed the business, dropped below the threshold or merged entities? An unused GSTIN is a liability: returns remain due, late fees accumulate and notices follow. Cancelling it properly is the only clean exit.
Eaccountingcart files your cancellation application, computes the tax payable on closing stock correctly and files the final return GSTR-10, so the department closes your file without questions.
what: GST cancellation is applied in Form REG-16, stating the reason such as discontinuation, transfer or turnover below threshold. Tax must be paid on closing stock of inputs and capital goods to the extent of credit availed. After the cancellation order, the final return GSTR-10 must be filed within three months.
who: Businesses that have shut down or discontinued operations
Taxpayers whose turnover has fallen below the registration threshold
Businesses merged, sold or converted into a new entity
Holders of duplicate or unused GSTINs taken in error
benefits: Stops Late Fee Accumulation
Once cancelled, no further returns fall due on the dead registration.
Prevents Future Notices
A properly closed GSTIN does not resurface as a compliance problem years later.
Correct Stock Tax Computation
We compute reversal on closing stock accurately so you pay only what is due.
Clean Records for New Ventures
Directors and proprietors keep a clean compliance history for future registrations.
Complete Closure
Final return GSTR-10 filed on time avoids the ten thousand rupee penalty.
documents: GST portal login credentials
Reason for cancellation with effective date
Details of closing stock with invoice wise values
Last filed returns and payment challans
Sale or transfer deed if business was transferred
Bank details for any refund due
process: Pre Cancellation Review
We check pending returns, dues and credits, and clear them so the application is not rejected.
Stock Computation
Tax payable on closing stock and capital goods is computed with proper working papers.
Application Filing
Form REG-16 is filed with the correct reason and effective date.
Query and Order
We respond to any officer query and obtain the cancellation order REG-19.
Final Return
GSTR-10 is filed within the deadline to close the registration completely.
fees_note: No government fee; tax on closing stock may be payable
why_us: Half done cancellations are common: application filed, final return forgotten, penalty issued. We run the process to complete closure and give you the full paper trail.
faqs: Can I just stop filing returns instead of cancelling?
No. Returns remain due until formal cancellation, and late fees grow daily. The department may cancel suo moto with adverse remarks, which hurts future registrations.
Do I have to pay tax on unsold stock?
Yes, credit availed on stock and capital goods held on the cancellation date must be reversed or tax paid, whichever applies. We compute this precisely so you do not overpay.
What is GSTR-10 and when is it due?
GSTR-10 is the final return filed within three months of the cancellation order. Missing it attracts a penalty of ten thousand rupees, so we track it as part of the service.
Can a cancelled GSTIN be restored?
If the department cancelled it for non filing, revocation can be applied within the prescribed window after clearing dues. We handle revocation cases regularly.

why_us: Refunds fail on documentation, not eligibility. Our claim files anticipate the officer's checklist, which is why clients whose claims were stuck for months come to us to refile them successfully.
faqs: How long does a GST refund actually take?

A complete, well documented claim is typically sanctioned within sixty days, with provisional refund of ninety percent for exporters often faster. Poorly documented claims cycle through deficiency memos for months.
Can I claim a refund of input credit if I export without paying IGST?
Yes. Exporters under LUT claim refund of unutilised input tax credit proportionate to export turnover. This is the most common and most scrutinised refund category.
What is an inverted duty refund?
When your inputs are taxed at a higher rate than your output, credit accumulates. The law allows a refund of this accumulation, computed by a prescribed formula that we prepare with full workings.
My refund application was rejected earlier. Can it be revived?
Depending on the reason, we can refile with corrected documentation or file an appeal against the rejection within the appeal window. Share your order on WhatsApp and we will assess it.

why_us: We reply to GST notices every week and know what closes them: verifiable reconciliations and precise legal grounds, not lengthy arguments. Send your notice for a free first read.
faqs: What should I do first after receiving a GST notice?
Note the deadline, do not panic and do not reply casually. Send the notice to a professional the same day. Early review gives time to build reconciliations that a rushed reply cannot.
What happens if I ignore a GST notice?

The officer decides the matter without your side, usually confirming the demand with interest and penalty. Recovery can follow through bank attachment. Even a request for more time is better than silence.
Why did I get a mismatch notice when I filed everything?
Most mismatch notices come from timing gaps or supplier defaults, your supplier did not file or filed late. A reconciliation explaining each difference usually resolves it.
Can penalties be avoided in a show cause case?
In many cases, paying tax with interest before or soon after the notice sharply reduces or eliminates penalty under the law. We evaluate whether contesting or settling is cheaper for you.
